title: Agent Prompt Response Policy
description: How a pane agent runtime responds when an agent stops on a prompt (workspace trust, tool permission, confirmation). Product file ships defaults; knowledge/personal/governance/agent-prompt-response-policy.json overlays it per installation. Consumed by libs/core/agent-prompt-response.ts.

launch_args.description: Extra CLI arguments per provider (or herdr kind) appended when the agent is started — the place for a provider's non-interactive or permission-mode flags. Empty by default: those flags widen what an agent may do without asking, so they are an installation decision.

auto_answer.description: Prompts answered without a person. Each rule must match the prompt signature and every condition it declares. A workspace_trust rule needs cwd_prefixes; a generic_confirm or agent_blocked rule needs excerpt_pattern — a rule that could answer any question is ignored.

cwd_prefixes.description: Absolute paths; {repo_root} and {repo_parent} are expanded. The agent's cwd must equal or sit under one of them.

excerpt_pattern.description: Case-insensitive regular expression the prompt text must match.

keys.description: herdr send-keys key names, e.g. ["enter"] or ["down", "enter"].

relay_keys.description: Keys sent after a person approves or rejects an escalated prompt, per signature, with 'default' as the fallback.

escalation_wait_ms.description: How long a turn waits for a person to decide an escalated prompt before failing as awaiting_human. The request stays open; the next turn relays a decision made later.
